reply_text:
I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler I'd use for a recurring 08:00 post fails with a gateway credentials error. No schedule exists, so nothing will post on 19 October or after, and I haven't posted a digest.

I replied to Bettina in the thread on her request in #coastal-team. I said:
- Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials. After that she can ask again and I'll create the job.
- Until then, she can ping me on any Monday and I'll build the digest on the spot from #coastal-team and #coastal-random.
- Everyone in those two channels is on the Coastal team, so a digest from them wouldn't go beyond what the team can already see.
